title: Ground truth annotations
description: What one independent annotator labels from the script or the full footage of a demo session (AGENTS.md §6): the eating and drinking episodes. data/eval reads it (also as a CSV with start and end columns) and scores a pipeline run against it. Times are ISO 8601 with an offset. Episodes the pipeline could not observe (privacy switch, excluded clip) are still annotated: the evaluation sets them aside using the coverage intervals.

annotator.description: Pseudonymous id of the annotator, e.g. a-01.

session.description: The upload_id or device_session_id the annotation is about.

start.description: When the episode starts, with an offset.

kind.description: Optional label such as meal, snack or drink.
